## Purpose

Describe the problem and the smallest change that addresses it. Link the relevant issue or release evidence.

## Scope

- Target branch: `main` (research/docs) / `deploy/vercel-hobby` (application) / other:
- Files and behavior changed:
- Model/dataset/inference altered? If yes, explain the separate research approval:
- Guest ownership, privacy, auth or deployed access affected? If yes, explain the threat assessment:

## Verification

| Check | Command / evidence | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Relevant tests | | |
| Type/lint/build (if applicable) | | |

List failed/retried checks as well as passing checks. Do not claim a cloud test from a local run.

## Scientific and release boundaries

- [ ] Synthetic data are labeled, and no field accuracy or savings are claimed.
- [ ] Frozen HGB/provenance and safety gates remain intact, or deviations have explicit review.
- [ ] No secrets, reviewer capability, private archive, licensed fonts or raw confidential logs were added.
- [ ] Deployment/PR state is described accurately; no implicit production promotion.
- [ ] Updated documentation and user-visible behavior are consistent.
